request.label: r3-refresh3-forecast
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json, sys
from resources import identity, atomic
from task2r_run import balance

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
evidence, ledger = root / "evidence", root / "accounting.json"
elapsed = evidence / "r3-time-perturbed-1-fd-fourfold.json"
failure = evidence / "r3-signed-cold-comparison.json"
prior = json.loads(elapsed.read_text())
cold = json.loads(failure.read_text())
assert prior["accepted_steps"] == 4 and cold["status"] == "NOT_MET"
assert cold["endpoint_time"] == .08 and cold["on_cadence_recovery"]["time"] == .04
assert all(row["coupled_newton"]["refreshes"]+row["coupled_newton"]["reuses"] == 3 for row in prior["observed"])
atomic(Path(sys.argv[2]),dict(schema="WJH27R3SignedRefreshThreeForecastV1",
    account=balance(json.loads(ledger.read_text())), ledger=identity(ledger),
    basis=[identity(elapsed),identity(failure)], timestep=.02, fd_step=4e-6,
    step_pc_maximum_uses=3, split_time=.04, endpoint_time=.08, numerical_step_cap=650,
    proposed_fresh_caps=[2250,1490], proposed_restart_cap=1650,
    independent_endpoint_audit_cap=1450, compare_cap=815,
    rationale="Three preconditioner bases per measured step give a fresh first base at the scheduled split in both branches.",
    measured_rebuild_seconds=prior["timing"]["engine_seconds"]["rebuild"],
    measured_complete_steps_seconds=prior["timing"]["complete_step_seconds"]))
